C x.ci-required-skills EX - ENFORCED ;; Required workflow skills (development-workflow, project-structure, verify, code-review, build-fix, custom-settings, git-workflow, security-scan, add-dependency, architecture-decision, template-maintenance), shared knowledge skills and selected module knowledge skills must exist with matching names and descriptions; template-maintenance must be user-only and all others model-invocable; long descriptions warn. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-manifest-checks EX - ENFORCED ;; Module manifests must have leak-tokens and binds lines, a facet table belonging to the slot, matching Capability headers, existing facet files with matching Capability/Facet/Level headers, valid JSON facets and every contract-required facet. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-capability-declarations EX - ENFORCED ;; A file declaring Capability must belong to a selected module and be listed in its manifest. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-rule-layout EX - ENFORCED ;; Rules live in a level directory matching their header Level, declare non-empty paths frontmatter, and rules in capability subdirectories declare Capability. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-imports EX - ENFORCED ;; CLAUDE.md imports must resolve and be 'Loading: always'; every 'Loading: always' artifact must be imported by CLAUDE.md. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-facet-refs EX - ENFORCED ;; Facet references (<slot>.<facet>) must resolve to facets declared by the selected module; references to an unselected required slot fail. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C wf010.ci-reviewer-readonly OL WF-010 ENFORCED ;; The code-reviewer agent must exist, disallow Write and Edit, and delegate to the code-review skill. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;;
C x.ci-references EX - ENFORCED ;; Named skill/agent references and backticked .claude/ path references must resolve. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-private-refs EX - ENFORCED ;; Skill-private references may be used only by their owning skill (or listed in the map). ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-map-coverage EX - ENFORCED ;; The instruction map must list every artifact and must not be imported by CLAUDE.md. ;; = ;; Checker run. ;; Repo/meta invariant.
